title: owner-gate
description: One open owner question shown as a gate (COMP-DOGFOOD-OWNER-QUEUE-1, row F of COMP-DOGFOOD-1). The owner queue (ops `claude/scripts/owner_queue.py`, `coordination/owner-queue.jsonl`) is the only writer: phone, chat, digest, the cockpit and MCP all answer the same record, first answer wins. Compose never stores an owner gate; it reads the queue and shows every open `asks` or `security` row (lib/owner-queue-class.js `groupOf`) as one of these. The ONE producer is lib/owner-gates.js `readOwnerGates`; its readers are the MCP `get_pending_gates` tool, `GET /api/fleet/owner-gates` (and the `queue` panel of `GET /api/fleet`, which the cockpit's `ownerAsks` reads), the day ribbon's `ownerWaits`, and `node lib/owner-gates-cli.js list`. An owner gate never expires: it is open until the queue closes it. `approve_gate` on an owner gate takes `option` (one of `options[].key`) and closes the row with `owner_queue.py close --channel mcp --if-version <version>`.

id.description: `owner:` then the queue id. The prefix keeps an owner gate from colliding with a Compose gate id (`<flowId>:<stepId>:<round>`).

kind.description: Tells an owner gate from a Compose policy gate in one list.

status.description: Only open rows become gates, so always pending.

group.description: `groupOf(text)`: a security row (resolve) or an ask (answer).

summary.description: The question without its leading tag (`stripTag`).

text.description: The record's text as written, tag included (the cockpit row keeps it).

unit.description: The unit the question blocks, when the asker named one.

post_id.description: The notify-service post id, when the record has one.

options.description: The answer options, plain English (lib/ask-options.js `optionsOf`: the record's `options`, else `(a) ... (b) ...` parsed from the text). Empty for a free-text ask or a security row; such a gate is answered on a channel that takes text (chat, phone, cockpit), never through approve_gate.

recommended.description: The record's `default` (the asker's recommendation), else null.

version.description: The record's precondition token, as `notify_client.version_of` computes it (`json.dumps(ts)`). approve_gate passes it as `--if-version`, so an answer to a question re-asked since it was read is refused OWNER_GATE_STALE.

opened_at.description: When the question was asked (the record's `ts`).
